fixes.rationale_full: One rule in one helper, BackendClient.closeConnection(plain, connection): close the plain socket first, then the SSLSocket quietly; for http (connection == plain) or null connection close once. Used by SocketBodyStream.close (Attempt now carries plain and socket), the 502/503 retry close, ProxyExchange.release and attach-after-release (closeConnection(backend) = recorded plain else backend, then backend), and TlsConnector.layer when a completed handshake is refused afterwards (held verifier reject or late deadline). A handshake that itself failed is not closed by the proxy: the provider ends it (JDK fatal alert sets tlsIsClosed; Conscrypt frees native state on a failed handshake), and closing it there would break REL-PROXY-002 AC-7 (WatchdogTest asserts 0 close() calls on the SSLSocket of a handshake ended by the deadline). Deadline paths (ProxyExchange.fire, plainSocket-after-fire, TlsConnector.Watchdog) still close only the plain socket, so the watchdog thread never touches an SSLSocket (REL-PROXY-002 AC-7/AC-9 unchanged). Thread safety: the only off-request-thread caller of release() is the res.onAbort listener (adapter or res.abort thread). JDK 17 SSLSocketImpl.close() after the plain socket is closed: tlsIsClosed false -> isConnected() true -> duplexCloseOutput -> closeNotify -> getSoLinger() delegates to the closed plain socket and throws SocketException before recordLock is taken; the catch then runs closeSocket(false), which only tryLock()s appInput.readLock and closes the (already closed) plain socket, then sets tlsIsClosed. No blocking lock is reached, and Socket.close() of the plain socket first makes any thread blocked in I/O on it fail at once, releasing its locks (also the basis on Conscrypt, where close() interrupts SSL and awaits pending ops that the closed fd ends). Proven by sec_PROXY_005_anAbortOnAnotherThreadClosesTheSslSocketWithoutWaitingForTheReader: request thread blocked reading a stalled https body, res.abort(null) on the test thread returns < 1000 ms with readTimeout 10 s and the SSLSocket is closed. No public symbol changed; Proxy's now-unused private closeQuietly(Socket) removed.
